verdict.rationale: Appwrite's first-party Storage docs cover uploading, downloading, listing, and deleting files, and serving them through a preview endpoint with image transformations such as resize, crop, convert, smart-crop gravity, and EXIF/metadata stripping. The pack has no storage-specific evidence for per-file or per-bucket access rules (the permissions mention concerns databases), and none for CDN-backed delivery. missing for 10: documented file/bucket access permissions, CDN-backed delivery, independent or hands-on corroboration.
